links.comparator_used: LLM given the PPG-derived rhythm without reliability evidence (baseline use of the measurement as a direct fact); also matched versus patient-disjoint shuffled evidence
links.outcome: Four repair and specificity endpoints (correct repair rate, evidence-specific repair margin, and conflict/context-induced error measures) in a 187-patient protocol-locked test
links.effect: Improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero
links.tradeoff: Utility harm rate (unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases) increased by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7), not statistically distinguishable from zero.
links.quote: On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7).

design_hint: Reliability evidence supplied to LLM for derived measurements
